anchor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FC House Style exploration anchor board
Primary request: Create one square 2x2 anchor board showing four separate fantasy subjects rendered by the same exact illustrator in one fully consistent visual style.
Scene/backdrop: Top-left panel: an adult medieval woman warrior in a village courtyard. Top-right panel: an adult brown bear in a forest clearing. Bottom-left panel: a four-legged, two-winged dragon on a rocky upland. Bottom-right panel: a small medieval village with houses, a well, and a watchtower.
Style/medium: Traditional fantasy storybook watercolor: believable but gently exaggerated forms, transparent layered washes on cold-press paper, soft color blooms and granulation, mostly soft edges with a few crisp inkless focal edges, large uncluttered shapes, and minimal colored-pencil accents only at faces and key materials. Mature and lyrical; no opaque digital painting, no cel shading, no glossy rendering.
Composition/framing: Square canvas divided into four equal panels with narrow clean gutters and no labels. Each subject and all essential anatomy must be complete, comfortably inside its panel, and safely framed. Each panel has one clear focal subject; the village panel is environment-only.
Lighting/mood: Neutral diffuse daylight in every panel; no inherited or shared dramatic mood.
Color palette: Natural local colors appropriate to each subject and setting; do not force a shared palette.
Constraints: The same exact artist, brushwork, edge language, shape simplification, detail density, and material handling in all four panels. Adult warrior. Bear has anatomically correct limbs and paws. Dragon has exactly four legs and two wings. Village contains no focal people or creatures. No fire, magic, dramatic sky, rim light, text, label, logo, watermark, decorative frame, enclosing panel borders, or extra focal subjects.

qa.notes: All four panels share cold-press paper grain, layered watercolor washes, inkless edge handling, restrained natural color, and consistent detail density; subjects and landmarks are safely framed.
